48// Fourth order identity tensor
49inline constexpr auto FourthOrderEye() {
50 NdArray<real, 3, 3, 3, 3> val = {};
51 for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
52 for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
53 val[i][j][i][j] += 1_r;
54 }
55 }
56 return val;
57}
58static constexpr NdArray<real, 3, 3, 3, 3> kFourthOrderEye = FourthOrderEye();
59
60inline constexpr auto FourthOrderEyeSym() {
61 NdArray<real, 3, 3, 3, 3> val = {};
62 for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
63 for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
64 for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) {
65 for (int l = 0; l < 3; ++l) {
66 val[i][j][k][l] = 1_r / 2_r *
67 (static_cast<real>(i == k) * static_cast<real>(j == l) +
68 static_cast<real>(i == l) * static_cast<real>(j == k));
69 }
70 }
71 }
72 }
73 return val;
74}
75static constexpr NdArray<real, 3, 3, 3, 3> kFourthOrderEyeSym = FourthOrderEyeSym();

77inline constexpr auto IouterI() {
78 NdArray<real, 3, 3, 3, 3> val = {};
79 for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
80 for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
81 for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) {
82 for (int l = 0; l < 3; ++l) {
83 val[i][j][k][l] = static_cast<real>(i == j) * static_cast<real>(k == l);
84 }
85 }
86 }
87 }
88 return val;
89}

92// Indices of face nodes within a parent tetrahedron. Note that 3-faceNum is excluded from each set
93// and the winding order ensures outward normals.
94// This ordering is used in two different processes:
95// - Create a boundary discretization of a finite-element tetrahedral mesh.
96// - Extract a triangle mesh from a tetrahedral mesh.
97struct TetFaces {
98 static constexpr NdArray<int, 4, 3> kIndices = {
99 Int3{0, 2, 1},
100 Int3{0, 1, 3},

102 Int3{1, 2, 3}};
103};
